name: Fos proto-oncogene, AP-1 transcription factor subunit

function.text: FOS encodes protein c-Fos. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
